cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Turn the kitchen tap on before I start washing up. I've tightened the loose joint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Wear my apron. I need to know whether the joint holds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear it and turn the tap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll need it dry for washing up. You can have my raincoat for the test.

mechanism: A makes testing its doubtful repair a pupil practical exercise before it exposes itself to the result.
confusable: Unlike asking someone to break a rule first, the uncertainty is whether A fix actually works.
comparison: Possible spray during repair test versus unpleasant cheap drink tasting.
seedUse: Use D32 tightened joint/apron/raincoat; S05 practical-training distinction shifts risk to B.
